description: This file is a CMake module script used to locate and configure the libcrun library, including checking for required variables, setting up imported targets, and handling errors if dependencies are missing.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of the libcrun.pc module and imports its variables.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other CMake modules, such as FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Validates that all required variables for libcrun are set and present.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds the actual library file for libcrun.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported library target for libcrun.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for the imported libcrun target, such as location and include directories.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs error messages if dependencies are missing or misconfigured.
